name: Spriggan Requiem
description: The ultimate king of spin. Spriggan Requiem reverses its spin direction mid-battle, making it immune to burst. Its divine aura nullifies all burst risk and heals continuously.

ability.name: Requiem Spirit
ability.description: Spriggan Requiem cannot burst. Each turn passively heals 8 HP. When HP drops below 40%, all stats permanently increase by 30 for the rest of the battle.

chain._note: Requiem Spirit: heals 8 HP per turn (8/700 ≈ 0.0114)
Requiem Spirit: +30 all stats permanently below 40% HP

Requiem Whip.name: Requiem Whip
Requiem Whip.description: Deals a three-hit Special, then converts its DEF and STM into additional ATK for the next 3 turns (ATK = ATK + DEF + STM). The conversion does not consume its DEF, STM, or current stamina.
flavour_texts: ⚡ **Hit 2** — The whip tears through the stadium walls!

Requiem Zone.name: Requiem Zone
Requiem Zone.description: Deals a four-hit Special, then enters Spin Absorption for the next 2 turns. Incoming normal Attack damage is absorbed instead of reducing HP and restores 1 stamina per 20 damage, up to its stamina cap. Enemy Specials, counters, and damage-over-time still deal damage.
flavour_texts: 🌑 **Requiem Zone** — The zone of absolute domination activates!

special_move.name: Requiem Whip
special_move.description: Deals a three-hit Special, then converts its DEF and STM into additional ATK for the next 3 turns (ATK = ATK + DEF + STM). The conversion does not consume its DEF, STM, or current stamina.
flavour_texts: ⚡ **Hit 2** — The whip tears through the stadium walls!

_note: dual_special=True: battle.py's DualSpecialView overwrites special_move + chosen_special at runtime. special_move is pre-seeded with Requiem Whip because tournament.py builds a BattleSession WITHOUT calling _resolve_dual_special — a null special_move there hits the resolve_special() fallback of 1 x 360 damage. Never let special_move go back to null.
